messages:
olivia: Heads-up — we're lining up a short pre-brief with a handful of analysts next week ahead of the Dedicated launch. Need to nail embargo window, who can be on the call, and quick quote sign-off flow. Can folks confirm availability and owners?

sam: I can take briefing ops and host the call. Available Tue/Wed morning PT.

anya: I can join for product + benchmarks. Need the benchmark narrative bullets beforehand.

olivia: Thanks. Proposed embargo: `2025-11-12T16:00:00Z` (public blog + press release). Analysts get a 24-hour fact-check window; embargo lifts at that timestamp. Is that OK for legal? @jane

jane: 24h is doable if we get fact-check docs and quotes by EOD the day before. Legal needs final quote language in plain text (no creative edits) to approve.

diego: Who's on the quote list? We should have one product quote and one exec quote. Product: Anya, Exec: Trevor?

trevor: I can do a short exec quote. Prefer to sign off on the exact wording.

olivia: Plan: send fact-check doc with 5 bullets + embargo rules + proposed quotes. Ask analysts to return any factual corrections only within 24h. Marketing will collect suggested quote edits, Legal approves, Execs sign off.

sam: I'll draft the attendee list. Suggested analysts: PlatformToday, EnterpriseAI, MLInfraDesk, and two boutique analysts (names in doc).

anya: Also include the benchmark methodology appendix. Some analysts will push on perf numbers.

olivia: Good call. I'll attach a short methodology appendix and a one-page benchmark narrative. Link to draft: https://redwood-internal.example.com/press/analyst-prebrief (private).

pressbot: calendar: Event created — "Analyst pre-brief: Dedicated launch" on 2025-11-10 16:00 PT. Invite sent to listed attendees.

sam: Quick ops checklist I'm tracking: 1) Lock embargo time (olivia/jane) 2) Finalize analyst list (sam) 3) Fact-check doc + benchmark appendix (anya) 4) Quote draft & legal loop (jane/trevor) 5) Send invites + materials 48h before call (sam)

olivia: Assigning owners: embargo & legal = jane; invites + logistics = sam; product narrative = anya; exec quote = trevor; marketing assets + press kit = me.

jane: I'll review the quote templates and send a legal-friendly phrasing checklist by EOD. Use this pattern: short declarative sentence, avoid superlatives, no competitor callouts.

diego: For fact-check returns: prefer a single consolidated thread rather than separate emails. Sam can collect and paste into the doc.

sam: Will do. Also, for embargo enforcement — we should include a single contact (olivia) for any immediate clarifications, and request analysts not to publish until the embargo lift.

olivia: Agreed. I'll be the contact. Also planning a short five-slide teaser deck for the call. Anyone object to sharing that with analysts ahead of time?

anya: Share the deck with handoff notes. Don't include raw cost numbers — keep to relative improvements and method.

trevor: Exec quote draft: "Redwood Dedicated brings predictable throughput and enterprise-grade controls that help teams move to production faster." I'll post a one-line that legal can trim.

jane: Good start. Legal edits: replace "enterprise-grade" with "enterprise controls" and remove "move to production faster" -> suggest "accelerate production readiness."

olivia: I'll incorporate legal edits and circulate final quote for Trevor sign-off by tomorrow noon PT.

pressbot: reminder: Fact-check doc deadline in 24 hours — 2025-11-11 12:00 PT.

sam: One more: press list — do we want embargoed exclusive to one outlet before general release? Pros/cons in deck.

diego: If we do a pre-brief exclusive, need comms plan for other outlets and additional embargo terms. I'd avoid unless top-tier ask.

olivia: Let's keep it non-exclusive for now. If a top-tier asks, we'll evaluate.

anya: I'll upload the benchmark appendix to the doc and mark the three most defensible claims with sources.

olivia: Perfect. After the call: 1) Consolidate analyst feedback 2) Apply corrections 3) Legal signs off on final quotes 4) Schedule press release for embargo lift. Sam — you OK owning post-call consolidation?

sam: Yep. I'll compile and ping owners for final sign-offs within 6 hours of call.

olivia: Thanks all. Final ask — no public sharing of the deck or numbers until embargo lifts. Reactions only in-thread. :lock:

trevor: Acknowledged.

jane: Acknowledged.

pressbot: note: Recording disabled by host."
